text.text_excerpt: One of the best guaranteed good-time spots on Bourbon Street. Yes, the place itself isn't all the great. It's big and open with two bars and a stage in front. Kind of dingy, and the ladies rooms aren't what I'd call pristine. But they play some good music. On my last visit I saw great performers ranging from a Temptations-like cover band with perfect harmonies and coordinated dance moves to an awesome classic rock band. This is also one of the only spots on Bourbon that keeps going late into the night. My favorite hang out spot on bourbon street (probably because i was under age and they didnt card) Awesome live music and cheap drinks. You will have a blast here.

I had so much fun here! I was in NOLA for a bachelorette party (what else right??) and we were walking down Bourbon after the drag show we watched for a fun place to drink and dance. The music coming out of this place was fun so we knew this had to be one of our spots that night. We walked into the Cupid shuffle. Not a lot of people knew the steps but people were trying! Great cover band inside. Did a really good job of having different genres, old and new. Really diverse crowd. There are a lot of shot girls going around, but I didn't try any (I try not to have my drinks have sugar in it since my old age is showing with my hangovers the next morning!)
